title: Fundamental to Applied Chemical Reactivity Across Interfaces and Droplets Conference
level: Scientists and graduate students (bachelor's degree in science/engineering required)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Fundamental to Applied Chemical Reactivity Across Interfaces and Droplets" will take place from 21 to 26 February 2027 in Oxnard, United States. Applications are due by 24 January 2027 via grc.org.
requirements: Undergraduates or those without a bachelor's degree in science/engineering (or acceptable equivalent) are not eligible to apply (GRC policy)
card_alt: Card for "Fundamental to Applied Chemical Reactivity Across Interfaces and Droplets Conference" by Gordon Research Conferences in Oxnard, United States; application deadline 24 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline in New York City, not Oxnard.
